training.loss: mean of two original final-sequence parity CEs via arithmetic gradient mean; each original full gradient measured separately

gradient_policy.policy: unchanged run_diff_sequence full-sequence BPTT; no token/state/cache detach; reset at independent-sequence boundary
gradient_policy.horizon: entire current sequence: 4..16 tokens in training; no inter-sequence graph
production_detach_locations: src/routing.py:137 hard - relaxed.detach() + relaxed; ST relaxed stop-gradient
gradient_policy.unused_detach: src/convergence.py detach helper is outside execute_differentiable
gradient_policy.clone_semantics: state.clone, cache.clone and memory write clones preserve autograd
gradient_policy.attention: GQA retains complete sequence; SWA window 256 retains 255 committed rows; no within-sequence eviction at these lengths
gradient_policy.convolution: GDN retains conv_kernel-1=3 inputs; existing finite convolution receptive field, no added gradient detach
gradient_policy.frozen_computations: T frozen backbone executes with autograd enabled
gradient_policy.diagnostic_detaches: copy/snapshot/probability/report tensors only; returned execution/final CE graph is not replaced
gradient_policy.anchor: original Prelude h_t,0 is passed unchanged to all successor blocks; observed for in-flight mutation

training.resets: independent sequence initialization per rollout; ordinary within-sequence evolution/commits
training.selection: fixed final checkpoint; no intermediate outcome evaluation

randomness.training_recipe: CPU Generator4900; historical visits in order; lane0 then lane1; FP32 rand[length,15,10]; tables are sealed, not consumed as a route-dependent flat stream
randomness.evaluation_recipe: four integer seeds from CPU Generator4903; each original IndexedNoise draws panel-order FP32[length,15,10] tensors
randomness.decision_axis: legal maximum D15 coverage, not a stopping cap

panel.Stage1_exposure: unknown; unretained historical input exposure cannot be excluded

uncertainty.unit: paired sequence; four stochastic outcomes kept together
uncertainty.conditional: one initialization and four locked noise tapes

decision_rules.helped: on each panel pooled stochastic T-C>=.10, paired95 interval excludes0, positive on>=3/4 tapes; deterministic T>=C on both panels
decision_rules.useful: additionally T>=.90 deterministic and pooled stochastic on each panel, and CE lower than untouched U for both deterministic and pooled stochastic panels
decision_rules.chance: valid mechanics and chance-level T means this repair failed within the declared budget

historical_integrity_exception: preserved bytecode-only identity failure; post-exception recorded diff/cache identities match; all experiment-relevant identities verified
focused_tests: 10 passed: seven new diagnostic-local tests plus three existing paired-noise tests; no Task-A training in tests; production tests unchanged
